activation_base_rule: exact current integration head that records T09 APPROVED and integrated

Verify T05, T08 and T09 are APPROVED in both dependency graph and workstream registry.
Verify the current integration head contains the accepted T09 integration/approval record.
Apply the emitted @reservation:T10 PATH_OWNERSHIP patch through the integration owner.
Claim T10 with workstream.py as ASSIGNED using the exact current integration head and @reservation:T10.
Set T10 dependency-graph/task-gate active state consistently through integration-owner governance update.
Validate registry and planned ownership collision checks.
Create havenline/T10-world-transformation from the exact post-activation integration head.
Push an empty initialization or first authorized T10 candidate and require candidate guard PASS before broader implementation.
claim_template: python3 tools/havenline/production/workstream.py claim T10 --owner world-transformation-builder --branch havenline/T10-world-transformation --base <POST_T09_INTEGRATION_SHA> --owned-alias @reservation:T10 --status ASSIGNED
notes: PREPARED work may continue while T09 is active; T10 runtime implementation remains dependency-gated.
T11 owns final camp structures and camp upgrade visuals; T10 owns reusable transformation transaction/state semantics.
T14 owns global save/versioning; T10 may only expose deterministic component snapshot/import state.
